newsitem.title: USA: Capstead sees modest dividend rise in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Capstead sees modest dividend rise in Q2.

text.p: Captstead Mortgage Corp said Thursday that it is optimistic about the remainder of the year and expects its common dividend to be modestly higher in the second quarter.
The Dallas-based mortgage banking and mortgage investment firm also said it expects mortgage serving profits to grow about 15 percent in 1997.

"We remain optimistic for the remainder of the year," the company said in a release. "The restructuring of our investment portfolio, improving results from mortgage servicing and the growth in both mortgage servicing and mortgage securities give us confidence that the common dividend with be modestly higher in the second quarter."
The company said it expects the common divdend to continue growing throughout 1997 in nearly any environment of rising or falling interest rates.

On Thursday Capstead reported first quarter fully diluted earnings of $0.58 a share on net of $37.4 million, compared with first quarter 1996 fully diluted earnings of $0.45 a share on net of $26.8 million.
